verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a generic alert-ingestion layer: alert routes and deduplication for alerts 'from your monitoring tools', plus an API for creating incidents from monitoring systems. The only named observability integration is an AWS connector that lets Rootly AI read CloudWatch metrics during investigations, which is a read-only lookup rather than alert ingestion. Missing for 10: any evidence of first-party Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or Sentry integrations; documented setup guides for those tools; CloudWatch alert ingestion beyond AI lookups; independent corroboration.
